title: Kusanagi Nene — Wonderlands×Showtime〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That was great! Thank you, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: See you tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: See you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Bye.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'll stay a bit longer to practice on my own.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Let's get you over there...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Robo-Nene, you'll be my audience.
I'll sing for you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(That went well.
No stage fright at all...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But can I sing like this when the audience is actually filled with real people? What if I forget the lyrics...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I hope you enjoyed my song!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm no longer afraid of performing on stage, but that's only thanks to you, Robo-Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Without you next to me, I lose confidence again...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm, this explains a lot.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So that's why you kept bringing Robo-Nene here, even though she's already served her original purpose.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You... You were spying on me?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, like the phantom of the opera, I appear unexpectedly.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So the answer is yes?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, I do apologize for eavesdropping.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Perhaps I can buy your forgiveness with this can of your favorite grapefruit juice?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You think my forgiveness is that cheap?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, I was hoping for a buddy discount.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Jokes aside...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm pleased that you've been taking such good care of Robo-Nene even though we haven't been using her for our shows.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She's already accomplished the mission I had set out for her when I built her...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But it seems it's too early to retire her. She's still needed.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I have a proposition. You would have to let me take her from you for a short while, though. Is that okay?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What are you planning to do? Modify her?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No. I just want to implement some upgrades.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What sort?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She has high functionality, but improvements could be made to usability.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm thinking of making it so that you could operate Robo-Nene while performing on stage alongside her.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You don't mind doing that for me?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Of course not. As the stage director, I'm happy to make any necessary accommodations for my troupe to perform at the best of their ability.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hmph...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Just remember I won't like it if you add any weird functions to her.
